Frequently asked questions

Short answers to common questions. For step-by-step instructions, see the guide.

Is Setlist Metronome free?
Yes. It is free to use, with no sign-up or account.
Is anything sent to a server?
No. The sound is made in your browser, and your songs and settings are saved only in your browser. See the privacy policy.
What does each song remember?
The title, tempo (BPM), time signature, rhythm, swing, sound, the accent of each beat, and the two volume settings.
Can I use my song list on another device?
Not at the moment. The list is saved in the browser where you made it, and is not shared between devices or browsers.
My song list disappeared.
The list is kept in the browser's site data. It is lost if the site data is cleared, in a private window, or, on some browsers, if the site has not been opened for a long time. Adding the app to your home screen and opening it from there makes this less likely.
What does BPM count in 6/8?
The bottom note of the time signature, so eighth notes in 6/8. If the music gives the tempo for a dotted quarter (♩. = 60), set 180 BPM. See time signatures explained.
What is the difference between Shuffle and Triplets?
Triplets play all three notes of each beat. Shuffle plays the first and last of them, so the off-beat comes late. Swing sets exactly how late. See shuffle and swing.
How do I play only some beats?
Tap a beat circle until it is dashed (silent). For example, silence beats 1 and 3 to hear only the backbeat.
How accurate is the timing?
The notes are scheduled on the browser's audio clock, which is much steadier than ordinary page timers. Bluetooth headphones and speakers add a delay to every note, so the beat stays even but comes slightly late. Use wired headphones or the device speaker when you play along with others.
Does it keep playing when I switch apps or lock the screen?
While the app is on screen, it asks the device to keep the screen on. On many phones the sound stops when you leave the browser or lock the screen; this depends on the device and the browser.
There is no sound.
Check that your device is not muted. On an iPhone, sound may not play when the silent switch is on. The first sound plays only after you tap Start or a sound button.
Does it work offline?
Yes. After you open the app once, it works without a connection. You can also add it to your home screen: on iPhone or iPad, tap Share and then Add to Home Screen; on Android, use the browser menu.
